text:
evelyn: Drafted the release notes entry for Adaptive Batching (beta). Key points: opt-in feature, improves throughput for short-completion workloads, recommended batch_size defaults and safety limits. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4301. Need Java SDK snippet and a short consumer-friendly blurb.

marc: Quick Q 1: did we finalize Java client API for streaming + batch helpers? last week there was a rename (`Client.builder()` -> `RedwoodClient.create()`). want to avoid landing a snippet that breaks.

evelyn: Good call. I updated Python and Go examples already and left a TODO for Java in the PR description: `SNIPPET_JAVA_PENDING`.

josh: I can pick up Java. Proposed minimal snippet for the new client: 
```java
// new style
RedwoodClient client = RedwoodClient.create(System.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"));
BatchRequest req = BatchRequest.builder().model("kitefish").batchSize(8).build();
BatchResponse resp = client.batch.create(req);
resp.getResults().forEach(r -> System.out.println(r.getEmbedding()));
```
Also included a backward-compat note showing `Client.builder()` for older library versions.

priya: ran the link-checker on the branch. Found a broken anchor: `/guides/batching#auto` -> should be `/reference/batching#auto`. I'll add a redirect rule and push a tiny netlify `_redirects` commit to the PR branch. Also one internal image missing alt text on the batching guide; fixed in a separate commit.

docs-bot: link-checker report: 1 broken anchor, 1 accessibility warning. Full report: https://ci.internal/reports/linkcheck/4301

marc: Small wording suggestion for the known-issues section: "If upstream load-balancers inject additional headers, the batching runtime may exceed the default request size limit and trigger throttling
. To opt out, set `batch.max_request_size` in your route config." Could we add a tiny YAML snippet for that?

evelyn: Yes please add the YAML snippet in the relnotes examples. Something like: 
```yaml
adaptive_batching:
  enabled: true
  batch_size: 8
  max_request_size: 1MB
```
I'll paste it into the relnotes.

josh: Pushed Java snippet and a one-line compatibility note to the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4301/files#diff-... Marked `SNIPPET_JAVA_PENDING` as done. Included both `RedwoodClient.create` and the legacy `Client.builder()` examples.

priya: Redirect commit pushed and CI link-checker is green now. Also ran the deploy preview smoke test and flagged one broken table layout; fixed a CSS class in the PR branch.

evelyn: Amazing, thanks everyone. Merge plan: wait for CI full green and then merge tomorrow at 11:00 PST, then publish release notes + short announce blurb. Can someone propose a single-line consumer blurb for social/announce?

marc: Draft blurb: "Adaptive Batching (beta): opt in to improve throughput for short responses; expect lower per-token costs for chat/assistant workloads. See migration guide for SDK examples and safety limits."

josh: LGTM, maybe shorten for tweet: "Adaptive Batching beta: boost throughput and lower per-token costs for short LLM calls. Opt-in; see docs for SDK examples."

docs-bot: deploy preview available: https://deploy-preview-4301--docs.redwood.ai/ (preview expires in 7 days)

evelyn: I'll merge once CI is green and tag the release note. Thanks all for the quick turnaround.
